description:
Starts recurring paid checks and notifications within the quoted limits until expiry. Call only after the person approves the search, channels, expiry, ceilings and minimum. Failed checks are charged at cost plus margin.

Permission: monitoring:manage. Ask the person before calling.

monitoring_id.description: The monitoring ID returned when it was quoted or created.

request_hash.description: The exact request_hash from the quote. Approval fails if anything changed since the quote.

name: approve_monitoring

maximumChargeMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.
